references.text: The introduction of Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, who rebelled against Moses.
Dathan and Abiram's continued refusal to obey Moses' call, where they repeat 'we will not come up'.
Moses goes himself to the tents of Dathan and Abiram after they refused to come to him.
A flashback to Dathan and Abiram who contended against Moses and Aaron.
Reference to what the Lord did with Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab.
The psalm recalls how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram's company.
Moses sent messengers and called together the elders of Israel, parallel to how Moses sends for Dathan and Abiram.
